nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.io.sge_backend
=====================================

.. py:module:: nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.io.sge_backend

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   SGE worker helpers for ``--backend`` / ``NVITK_BACKEND``.

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: sge_backend_cli_args(backend: str = 'gpu') -> list[str]

   Shell-quoted ``--backend <backend>`` CLI argv fragment for a worker command.


.. py:function:: sge_stage_extra_env(src_bind: str, backend: str = 'gpu') -> dict[str, str]

   Extra environment variables to set for an SGE worker running with *backend* (delegates to
   :func:`~nvitk.core.click_backend.sge_backend_env`).


.. py:function:: sge_backend_is_gpu(backend: str) -> bool

   True if *backend* (case-insensitive) is ``"gpu"``.


.. py:function:: sge_stage_ngpu(backend: str, *, request_gpu: bool | None = None) -> int

   ``qsub -l ngpu=…`` count; ``0`` omits the request (CPU job).


.. py:function:: sge_stage_use_nv(backend: str, *, request_gpu: bool | None = None) -> bool

   Whether the outer ``singularity exec`` should pass ``--nv``.


.. py:function:: sge_qvtpy_stage_resources(backend: str, *, request_gpu: bool | None = None) -> nvitk.cluster.sge.SgeResources

   Build :class:`~nvitk.cluster.sge.SgeResources` from CLI ``--backend``.


.. py:function:: sge_qvtpy_array_resources(backend: str, *, include_eicab: bool = False, eicab_device: str = 'cpu', eicab_pe_smp: int | None = None) -> tuple[nvitk.cluster.sge.SgeResources, bool]

   Padded resources for a per-subject qvtpy array job.

   Uses qvtpy project/account/queue. When *include_eicab* is true, bumps
   ``h_vmem`` / ``ngpu`` / ``pe_smp`` / ``use_nv`` so the shared request covers
   the eICAB task.

   Returns ``(resources, use_nv)``.
